decisions.reason: As a close extension of the existing portfolio in a growing market, the compact dumper still has option value and is inexpensive to support through shared engineering, sales and service resources.
The articulated construction dumper fits the firm's established construction equipment business, so with uncertainty still early and complementarities high, management would keep the option open.

Although the underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core range and therefore costlier and riskier to maintain, after only one year the uncertainty is not yet resolved enough to justify abandoning it outright.
The compact telescopic loader builds on the firm's known capabilities and customer base, making it a relatively low-cost adjacent option that should be retained pending more market evidence.
